# Cockroach Browser

> Powerful local-first browser automation for AI agents with real Chromium, isolated profiles, MCP, Maqam approvals, and verifiable evidence.

Canonical website: https://cockroachbrowser.com
Repository: https://github.com/AjnasNB/cockroach-browser
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/cockroach-browser
Technical paper: https://cockroachbrowser.com/paper/
Alternatives and product-layer comparison: https://cockroachbrowser.com/alternatives/
Open-source governed-agent ecosystem: https://cockroachbrowser.com/ecosystem/

## Alternatives and product layers
This comparison uses each project's official documentation and describes product scope, deployment, and control boundaries. It does not publish a speed, task-success, or security ranking because there is no shared benchmark across these product categories.

- [Playwright](https://cockroachbrowser.com/alternatives/#playwright): Cross-browser testing and automation across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit with direct APIs.
- [Puppeteer](https://cockroachbrowser.com/alternatives/#puppeteer): A JavaScript API for controlling Chrome or Firefox over the DevTools Protocol or WebDriver BiDi.
- [Selenium](https://cockroachbrowser.com/alternatives/#selenium): WebDriver-based browser automation with local or remote execution and broad language and browser support.
- [Playwright MCP](https://cockroachbrowser.com/alternatives/#playwright-mcp): MCP browser tools backed by Playwright and structured accessibility snapshots for agent interaction.
- [Chrome DevTools MCP](https://cockroachbrowser.com/alternatives/#chrome-devtools-mcp): Chrome automation, debugging, network inspection, console analysis, and performance tracing for coding agents.
- [Browser Use](https://cockroachbrowser.com/alternatives/#browser-use): A Python browser-agent framework and hosted platform for model-directed web tasks, custom tools, and recovery loops.
- [Stagehand](https://cockroachbrowser.com/alternatives/#stagehand): Browser automation with natural-language and code primitives for act, extract, observe, and autonomous agent workflows.
- [Browserbase](https://cockroachbrowser.com/alternatives/#browserbase): Managed cloud browser sessions with connection URLs, observability, recordings, contexts, and automation-framework integrations.
- [Browserless](https://cockroachbrowser.com/alternatives/#browserless): Managed headless browsers plus WebSocket, REST, and GraphQL interfaces for Puppeteer, Playwright, Selenium, scraping, screenshots, and PDFs.

## Open-source governed-agent ecosystem
This page maps documented product centers and composition boundaries from official project sources. It does not publish a shared performance benchmark, security ranking, production-capacity result, or universal winner.

- [Qarinah](https://cockroachbrowser.com/ecosystem/#qarinah): Local-first, evidence-linked project memory and compact cited handoffs for coding agents. Qarinah can provide cited project context before a browser task. It does not control browser execution or approve a side effect.
- [Maqam](https://cockroachbrowser.com/ecosystem/#maqam): A compact TypeScript boundary for policy, exact-input approval, one-use dispatch, execution, and receipts. Cockroach Browser ships a Maqam adapter for consequential browser actions. Maqam remains a separate authority and is not part of the browser engine.
- [Cockroach Browser](https://cockroachbrowser.com/ecosystem/#cockroach-browser): A local-first TypeScript runtime for authorized browser sessions, semantic refs, finite budgets, evidence, and receipts. Cockroach Browser uses playwright-core. It is not a browser engine and does not replace Playwright.
- [Cockroach Crawler](https://cockroachbrowser.com/ecosystem/#cockroach-crawler): Local web crawling, mapping, rendering, extraction, and normalized evidence with explicit network and resource limits. Cockroach Browser handles stateful interaction. Cockroach Crawler handles breadth. Its opt-in quality option is Trafilatura-backed and delegates main-content extraction to exact trafilatura@0.2.0.
- [Playwright](https://cockroachbrowser.com/ecosystem/#playwright): Cross-browser automation across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit with direct APIs and testing tools. Cockroach Browser depends on playwright-core and adds an agent-oriented authority, transport, and evidence contract above it.
- [Puppeteer](https://cockroachbrowser.com/ecosystem/#puppeteer): A JavaScript API for controlling Chrome and Firefox through browser protocols. Cockroach Browser is not presented as a Puppeteer speed, compatibility, or browser-coverage winner.
- [Browser Use](https://cockroachbrowser.com/ecosystem/#browser-use): An open-source Python framework for model-directed agents that interact with websites. Cockroach Browser keeps model selection and planning outside its runtime and can serve as a bounded execution layer for a separately designed host.
- [Stagehand](https://cockroachbrowser.com/ecosystem/#stagehand): Open-source AI browser automation that combines code with model-powered observation, action, and extraction. Stagehand centers AI-assisted browser automation. Cockroach Browser centers admitted session authority, finite budgets, and evidence.
- [Firecrawl](https://cockroachbrowser.com/ecosystem/#firecrawl): A web API and open-source project for search, scrape, crawl, map, and browser interaction. Firecrawl and Cockroach Browser address different centers: managed web data versus authorized stateful browser execution.
- [Trafilatura](https://cockroachbrowser.com/ecosystem/#trafilatura): Web text, metadata, comments, discovery, and structured output with configurable extraction. Cockroach Crawler's opt-in quality path delegates main-content extraction to exact trafilatura@0.2.0. Cockroach Browser does not replace an extraction specialist.
- [Docling](https://cockroachbrowser.com/ecosystem/#docling): Conversion of PDFs, office documents, images, HTML, and Markdown into a structured document representation. Docling is a document specialist. Cockroach Browser can acquire a file through an authorized session, but it does not claim Docling's conversion scope.
- [LangGraph](https://cockroachbrowser.com/ecosystem/#langgraph): A low-level runtime for long-running, stateful agents with durable execution, streaming, and human involvement. LangGraph can orchestrate a browser tool. Cockroach Browser does not replace its workflow state or agent runtime.
- [OpenAI Agents SDK](https://cockroachbrowser.com/ecosystem/#openai-agents-sdk): A TypeScript SDK for agent loops, tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions, tracing, and human involvement. The SDK can call Cockroach Browser as a tool. Cockroach Browser does not replace its model loop, handoffs, sessions, or tracing.

## Security boundary
Cockroach Browser detects login, consent, CAPTCHA, and access challenges, pauses automation, and waits for a human or authorized resolver. It does not bypass CAPTCHAs or access controls.

## Capability states
- Available: implemented in the 0.3.0 runtime or shipped deployment surface.
- Adapter: integration contract shipped, external authority or package required.
- Planned: documented direction, not part of the current release.
